name: @agentforge/desktop
description: Electron shell for Agentforge. Packaged builds bind an ephemeral loopback port, never 3000.

scripts.desktop-build: node scripts/check-symlink.mjs && pnpm --filter @agentforge/web build && node scripts/stage-web.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.desktop-build-dir: node scripts/check-symlink.mjs && pnpm --filter @agentforge/web build && node scripts/stage-web.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --dir
